sources.claim: Six per-response RPM/RPD headers; Free without payment method and Developer with payment method. Llama 3.3 70B Free: 20 RPM, 20 RPD, 200000 TPD; Developer: 240 RPM, 48000 RPD, plus 20M tokens/day across models. Reset is time until reset; format/unit not specified.
Cloud key generation in portal; up to 25 keys/user, new keys visible only once. SambaStack uses separate local credentials.
Inference/model paths and Bearer API key; no account billing or quota reader among the inspected paths.
SDK uses API key authentication; inspected client does not establish a browser/device OAuth login.
Same-origin GET /api/usage?user_name=&start_date=&end_date= with optional model_id and api_key_hash; /api/credits?user_name= and /api/auth:me. No account request made.
UTC month selection and model_wise_usage with input_token, output_token and separate pricing fields.
GET /resources/credits/balance has amount and readAt; UI settling notice, 300s client cache and 5s refresh cooldown are not backend freshness guarantees.
credits[] consumed with credit_value, balance_credit_value, end_date, credit_type; client divides credit values by 100.
POST /api/keys accepts userName, apiKeyName, optional expiresAt; response/session contract not qualified and operation not called.
Create UI submits userName, apiKeyName, optional expiresAt; response apiKey and apiKeyInfo.name are passed to success callback. Supplies prior missing raw-key response evidence; no account call made.

sources.claim: Inspected index contains inference/agent/storage APIs and rate guides; no documented general billing/quota API or OAuth/device login entry.
Request usage contains prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens and completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens.
RPM/TPM/RPS/PPM differentiated by capability and commitment/legacy tier. Solar Mini 4 Tier 0: 100 RPM and 50000 TPM, published limits rather than observed remaining.
Advertises $10 signup credit, paid PAYG and prepaid; does not establish individual credit grant or expiry.

Organization owns keys, billing and limits. Member can read Org balance/spend/limits but per-key usage only own keys; Owner all keys. Usage UTC filters up to 92 days/CSV. Monthly budget UTC with up to 1s enforcement delay; exhausted credit can charge payment method.

Same-origin /api/console/v3 BFF, credentials same-origin, x-console-request: 1. Org GET spend, promotions, usage-limit, rate-limit, usage/export. Spend month_to_date/period; money amount_decimal.value*10**exp; promotions credit_balance/total_credit/credit_coupons with paid/expiry. Org API key create/reveal path constants also exist. No private endpoint requested.
Official cookbook is an integration/example source; it does not establish a general third-party OAuth login or billing-reader contract.
POST Organization /api-keys with name/note returns key and api_key.key_id; GET /reveal returns key. Actual create/reveal implementations, not just path constants.
